howToEdit: Add a new object at the TOP of posts so it shows first. date is YYYY-MM-DD. side must be java, bedrock, or both. body is plain text; use a blank line between paragraphs. Keep the tone friendly for all ages. End with a reason to open Discord.

posts.title: Java built the towers. Bedrock filled the streets.
posts.body:
Java and Bedrock play in the same city. You can stand on the same stairs and argue about whose door is cooler.

Pick a team for fun. Then come play together.

Pictures, trades, and “come see this” happen on Discord.

posts.title: The city is open
posts.body:
Endcity is a survival world for Java and Bedrock. You can stand in the same city and play together.

Java: type endcity.net. Bedrock: add joinendcity in Social, then join.

After you get in, open Discord so you know when something fun is happening.

posts.title: The shop changes prices
posts.body:
If everyone sells cobble, cobble pays less. If everyone buys chorus fruit, it costs more. That’s the extra game.

Java and Bedrock use the same coins.

Talk shop on Discord — that’s where people say “don’t sell yet.”
